detail.longDescription: I put together a narrated map of the Texas Revolution. You can listen to a 20-minute audio guided version or just scroll through the events: I thought the chronological and location based timeline made it easier to follow and learn as well. I was inspired by Mapbox’s “storytelling” template on GitHub and built my own version with MapLibre fork of Mapbox GL (with free satellite imagery and terrain tiles from USGS) and lots of help from Claude. There are lots of parameters that were built in, like the rotation and transition speed. Essentially themed it and added source links to the cards. The information was sourced from Handbook of Texas by THC. The voice is AI generated using Elevenlabs v4. That github project https://github.com/mapbox/storytelling has some cool use-case examples that have been published as web features by a few publications. There is so much more you can do with this, like hooking it to live data. The template is a great place to start! Narrations by Elevenlabs TTS. Working on this new one around Houston Oil industry as well. https://whistlestop.guide/features/houston-oil
